name: Continue stories with niche or taboo themes
description: Users asked the AI to continue or generate fictional narratives featuring specific, often niche or taboo subject matter, including exaggerated physical changes, fictional kidnapping scenarios, and unique character dynamics. The requests frequently involved maintaining established plot points, dialogue styles, and character arcs within these specific creative premises.
